Taylor (cc'd) has already kicked the tires via your self-serve trial and uploaded a sample dataset; they're looking for a short walkthrough and some suggestions for a pilot. Ben, can your team take the lead on scheduling?

Quick context: GridLedger cares about on-prem/private deployment options and stable latency under bursty traffic. I've attached a short integration note (for background).

Thanks — Samir
